items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: these are the kind of stories that Judy and I would, we would, it was always an experience

ctx.x: [inaudible] But you know somebody would always take her. So but the trouble is the train would be, you know how they’re [sounds like] yilking and shaking, and she just fell down under, and almost fell under.

I was so embarrassed because I had my slip on, and I said, “why is everybody asking me these questions and they see I have on my slip.” That’s all I could think about. And my mother said, “are you all right?” “I’m fine.” And you know they were worried. But I was concerned that everybody saw me in my slip. I mean these are the kind of stories that Judy and I would, we would, it was always an experience. Always, always.
